Risk severity is high for public launch and medium for bounded changes that add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: retain private launch gates, continue existing read-only evidence work, and permit only bounded reversible growth within existing consent, disclosure, data-handling, and claims boundaries.
